 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Shailendra Singh
 Oral Order
1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 712 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. At the outset, it is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that marriage of the petitioner with the complainant took place in the year 2018 and thereafter his wife lived happily in the petitioner's house for four years and thereafter she filed the complaint case against him and others and in between both the spouses no conciliation has been done Patna High Court CR.

MISC. 
No.69222 of 2023(2) dt.08-11-2023 till date and

the petitioner wants conciliation meeting with his wife.

sentences.text: Considering the above submissions, let the notice under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process be sent to O.P. No. 2, for which necessary requisites etc. must be filed by the petitioner within twenty five days from the date of this order.
5. In the meantime, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner till further order.
6. Let the matter be listed on 13.12.2023 after service report of the notice upon O.P. No. 2.

(Shailendra Singh, J) BKS/-
